mapper.select: SELECT lexeme FROM unnest(to_tsvector('jiebacfg', #{text})) WHERE btrim(lexeme) <> '' ORDER BY lexeme

SELECT count(*) AS total_docs, coalesce(avg(t.len), 0)::float8 AS avg_doc_length FROM ( SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(array_length(u.positions, 1)), 0) FROM unnest(kv.text_tsv) u WHERE btrim(u.lexeme) <> '') AS len FROM knowledge_vectors kv ) t
SELECT u.lexeme AS lexeme, count(*) AS doc_freq FROM knowledge_vectors kv, unnest(kv.text_tsv) u WHERE kv.text_tsv @@ () AND u.lexeme IN #{t} GROUP BY u.lexeme
SELECT chunk_id AS chunkId, doc_type AS docType, section_path AS sectionPath FROM knowledge_vectors WHERE section_path IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chunk_id

SELECT chunk_id AS chunkId, doc_type AS docType, section_path AS sectionPath, left(text, 120) AS text FROM knowledge_vectors WHERE text_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('jiebacfg', #{keyword}) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(text_tsv, plainto_tsquery('jiebacfg', #{keyword})) DESC, chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}
